# T Nails & Spa

> Nail salon & spa based in Austin, Texas. T Nails & Spa on North Mopac is where Yen does nail art, Kim gives the best pedis and Jennifer and Cindy keep regulars coming back, with same-day appointments and a relaxing room.

- Phone: (512) 491-7337
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Leander
- Yelp rating: 4.2 from 343 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/t-nails-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/t-nails-spa/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Nail art: French tips, chrome, seasonal designs and art copied from your photo.

## About
T Nails & Spa sits on North Mopac near Parmer. Nail artist Yen, pedicure pro Kim, Jennifer, Cindy and the team do gel, acrylic, art, pedicures and waxing. Clients say the vibe is clean, fun and relaxing, they fit you in before close or same day, and they're honest about what a design will look like before they start. One client has seen Cindy for seven years.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at T Nails & Spa?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (512) 491-7337 or book online.
- Q: Where is T Nails & Spa?
  A: 12001 N Mopac Expy, Ste H, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about T Nails?
  A: T Nails & Spa is rated 4.2 stars from 343 Yelp reviews. Clients mention real nail artists, the best pedicures and a clean, fun vibe.
